Train an AnyMoE gating layer over LoRA adapter experts, then chat with the combined model.

```python
"""Train an AnyMoE gating layer over LoRA adapter experts, then chat with the combined model."""

import inference_rs as ir
from inference_rs import types as t

spec = t.EngineSpec(
    model=t.ModelSelectedPlain(
        model_id="mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1",
        arch=t.NormalLoaderType.MISTRAL,
    ),
    anymoe=t.AnyMoeSpec(
        config=t.AnyMoeConfig(
            hidden_size=4096,
            expert_type=t.AnyMoeExpertTypeLoraAdapter(
                rank=64, alpha=16.0, target_modules=["gate_proj"]
            ),
            lr=1e-3,
            epochs=100,
            batch_size=4,
            # For inference with a pretrained gating layer, see anymoe_inference.py
            loss_csv_path="loss.csv",
        ),
        path="examples/amoe.json",
        prefix="model.layers",
        mlp="mlp",
        model_ids=["typeof/zephyr-7b-beta-lora"],
    ),
)

with ir.Engine(spec) as engine:
    res = engine.chat(
        t.ChatCompletionRequest(
            model="default",
            messages=[
                t.Message(
                    role="user", content="Tell me a story about the Rust type system."
                )
            ],
            max_tokens=256,
            presence_penalty=1.0,
            top_p=0.1,
            temperature=0.1,
        )
    )
    print(res.choices[0].message.content)
    print(res.usage)
```
